Our Culture, Employees and Human Capital
paragraphs: Expensify is a leading cloud-based expense management software platform that helps the smallest to the largest businesses simplify the way they manage money. Every day, people from all walks of life in organizations around the world use Expensify to scan and reimburse receipts from flights, hotels, coffee shops, office supplies and ride shares. Since our founding in 2008, we have added over 15 million members to our community, and processed and automated over 1.8 billion expense transactions on our platform as of December 31, 2025, freeing people to spend less time managing expenses and more time doing the things they love. For the quarter ended December 31, 2025, an average of 650,000 paid members across an average of 39,700 companies and over 200 countries and territories used Expensify to make money easy.

Small and medium-sized businesses ("SMBs") are the cornerstone of the global economy, making up almost all businesses and the majority of employment in Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development ("OECD") member countries. Despite their significance to the global economy, the vast majority of SMBs still rely on manual, inefficient processes to manage the critical back office functions that power their businesses every day. Expense management, which refers to the collection, processing, auditing and reimbursement of employee expenses, is one of the last great holdouts of paper-based back office processes, with employees stuffing actual physical receipts into an envelope and handing it to their accountant. As SMBs seek to modernize back office functions like expense management to better compete in today's digital economy, we believe they will look for comprehensive technologies that are easy to discover, implement, purchase, manage and use. At the same time, individual employees are becoming a powerful source of change as they increasingly expect to bring their own choice of technology into the workplace.

Since the beginning of Expensify, our guiding principle has been improving the experience of the actual end users of expense management software: everyday employees. We designed Expensify to be easy to set up, integrate, configure and use from almost any device, which has enabled us to serve employees of all types and organizations of all sizes, industries and geographies. Our first breakthrough was revolutionizing receipt tracking with our patented scanning technology, SmartScan, which allows anyone to simply take a photo of any receipt – no matter the currency or quality of handwriting – for fast, automatic and accurate transcription of a receipt with just one tap. After removing the need for people to keep a pocket full of crumbled receipts and spend hours manually tracking expenses, we moved on to automating the entire expense journey, from the initial receipt scan all the way through to categorization, expense approval, reconciliation and next-day reimbursement. Since then, we have expanded our platform to include features that help businesses manage corporate credit cards, generate and send invoices, pay bills, collect payments and book travel, all from our single, easy-to-use mobile application. We intend to continue adding complementary features to retain and add value to existing customers and attract new members.

Our intense focus on improving the everyday experience of regular employees with an easy-to-use but powerful platform has enabled a viral, bottom-up business model that is capital efficient and extremely scalable. By allowing people to spend less time managing receipts and more time pursuing their real goals, our members have adopted, championed and spread Expensify to their colleagues, managers and friends. We believe our happy members are the best form of marketing, and our self-service, bottom-up approach takes advantage of strong, organic word-of-mouth adoption.

Behind our platform is a company with passionate people and a unique culture that guides everything we do. Our company operates with a flat, generalist organizational structure united by a robust set of common values that foster the long-term happiness and retention of our employees. The efficiency of our

business model allows us to prioritize attracting, retaining and inspiring talented, ambitious and humble people committed to a long-term vision. We are a team that likes to solve real problems, and though expense reports are problematic for most people, there are other pressing problems facing our world that we want to also help solve.

Given their size, SMBs typically have one person overseeing the discovery and implementation of new systems, a responsibility that is often in addition to their core job function. As a result, SMBs have specific requirements when adopting new technologies:

•Easy to discover. With job responsibilities spanning multiple functions, SMBs do not have the bandwidth and expertise to discover, meet with and evaluate several technology vendors. As such, SMBs increasingly rely on online channels for finding new technologies and heavily consider recommendations from experts, friends and colleagues.

•Easy to implement. IT departments within SMBs are often one person or the business owner themselves, and are incapable of taking time away from their business to support cumbersome implementation, maintenance and training requirements. As a result, SMBs prefer solutions that are easy to implement, onboard and integrate and that require little ongoing maintenance.

•Easy to purchase. With no procurement department and limited resources, the individuals making the purchasing decision at SMBs often prefer vendors with transparent, self-service monthly subscription plans that can be paid by credit card.

•Easy to manage. Unlike large enterprises, which often prefer multiple, customized point solutions for specialized business processes, SMBs prefer a single, comprehensive platform from one provider that can solve multiple pain points.
•Easy to use. Many SMBs prioritize ease of use and convenience over cost and seek solutions with elegant, intuitive user experiences that require no training or expertise to operate.
In short, SMBs look for "easy money" management. OUR APPROACH

Expensify is a cloud-based expense management software platform that helps the smallest to the largest businesses simplify the way they manage money. Every day, people from all walks of life in organizations around the world use Expensify to scan and reimburse receipts from flights, hotels, coffee shops, office supplies and ride shares. Since our founding in 2008, we have added over 15 million members to our community and processed and automated over 1.8 billion expense transactions on our platform as of December 31, 2025, freeing people to spend less time managing expenses and more time doing the things they love. For the year ended December 31, 2025, an average of 650,000 paid members across an average of 39,700 companies and over 200 countries and territories used Expensify to make money easy.

Our employee-centric product strategy, viral and bottom-up business model, word-of-mouth adoption and unique company culture come together to drive value for our members and a competitive advantage for us. We believe that if we remain hyper-focused on our end-user members, and build great products, our members will continue to drive adoption.

We primarily generate revenue from annual subscriptions to our cloud-based platform, driven by the number of paid members active on a monthly basis. Individuals or companies pay for subscriptions on behalf of themselves, their employees and contractors, who we collectively refer to as members. We define a customer as any member who pays for themselves and zero or more other members, grouped into one or more "expense policies." This might be an individual, an entire company, or a department of a larger company. The definition of customer inherently excludes sole proprietors on Track or Submit plans.

We monetize transactions from the Expensify Card by receiving interchange for all spend on the card. As we expand our platform, we continue to increase the number of integrations and to more actively promote the Expensify Card with complementary use cases beyond expense management to both new and existing customers to drive increased adoption.

We monetize bookings via Expensify Travel by charging a booking fee on each booking. We intend to continue to develop complimentary features to Expensify Travel to increase the number of existing companies using Expensify Travel and to attract new customers.
Our performance depends on many factors, including the following: INVESTING IN PRODUCT-LED GROWTH

We continue to focus on growing the number of paid members on our platform. Relative to other software companies, we invest more in product development and less in sales. This investment in product allows us to develop easy-to-use but powerful features that encourage adoption of our platform. Our ability to grow our paid members depends on our viral, bottom-up adoption cycle that starts with an individual employee. After downloading our free app to submit expenses and realizing the benefits of Expensify, our enthusiastic members champion our platform internally, spread it via word-of-mouth or invites to other

employees and often convince decision makers to adopt Expensify company-wide. In order to continue to grow, we believe we must continue prioritizing investments in our platform to delight our members and drive viral expansion.

Our success depends on converting users who try the free aspects of the Expensify platform into paid members. While our viral model means that employees or contractors often introduce Expensify into small and medium-sized businesses ("SMBs"), companies subscribe and pay for the majority of our paid members.

Our viral and word-of-mouth adoption model is effective in part because we have established ourselves as a recognized leader in expense management for SMBs. We deploy large scale brand advertising to promote our platform strength and create market consensus that Expensify is a category leader for expense management software. For example, in 2024 and 2025, we invested in a promotional marketing opportunity to have Expensify heavily featured in Apple's biggest budget film, F1® The Movie, which was released in theaters on June 27, 2025. We believe investing in market consensus enables us to focus on creating great viral features for our members rather than relying on low-margin, unscalable activities of traditional sales and marketing to drive customer acquisition.

Expense management touches many functions across a company. To provide a seamless experience for our customers, we integrate with accounting, ERP and travel software used by SMBs and their employees every day. We also have frictionless integrations with many of the technology providers that generate the most receipts for our members, such as Uber and Lyft. Expensify delivers an expense management platform that we believe customers like, and that embeds us within organizations. Because of these two factors, we have historically enjoyed high customer retention rates that often outperform enterprise retention rates. We believe an additional factor that drives our retention rates is that SMBs generally re-evaluate their technology solutions less frequently, and as such, there is rarely a conscious choice around whether to choose to continue using Expensify for another year.

Gross logo retention and net seat retention are important indicators of customer satisfaction and usage of our platform. We calculate our gross logo retention rate as of the end of a period by using (a) the number of distinct companies who have ever had five or more paid members paying for a subscription during the period ending one year prior as the denominator and (b) the number of those same companies that are still paying for at least one subscription during the more recent period as the numerator. In each of 2025 and 2024, our annual gross logo retention was 81%. We calculate our net seat retention rate as of the end of a period by using (a) the number of paid member seats from companies who have ever had five or more paid members paying for a subscription during the period ending one year prior as the denominator and (b) the number of paid member seats at those same companies during the more recent period as the numerator. In 2025 and 2024, our net seat retention was 88% and 86%, respectively. Our growth will depend on our ability to retain existing customers.

paragraphs: Expensify 是一個領先的雲端-based 費用管理軟體平台，協助從最小到最大規模的企業簡化他們管理金錢的方式。每一天，來自世界各地各個領域的組織人員使用 Expensify 掃描並報銷飛機票、飯店、咖啡廳、辦公用品及計程車等收據。自 2008 年創立以來，我們已將超過 15 百萬名成員加入我們的社羣，並在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止，於平台上處理並自動化超過 1.8 十億筆費用交易，讓人們花較少時間管理費用，而能花更多時間做他們喜愛的事。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為期的季度，平均有 650,000 名付費成員，來自平均 39,700 家公司，以及超過 200 個國家與地區，使用 Expensify 來讓錢變得輕鬆。

中小企業（"SMBs"）是全球經濟的基石，佔據幾乎所有企業以及經合組織（"OECD"）成員國中大多數的就業機會。儘管中小企業對全球經濟有重要影響，但絕大多數中小企業仍依賴手動且低效率的流程來管理每天推動其業務運作的關鍵後臺功能。費用管理，指的是員工費用的收集、處理、審核與報銷，是紙本後臺流程最後的抵抗者之一，員工會將實際的紙本收據放入信封中交給會計師。當中小企業尋求現代化如費用管理等後臺功能，以更好地競爭在當前的數位經濟中，我們認為他們會尋找易於發現、實作、購買、管理與使用的綜合性技術。同時，個別員工正成為強大的變革來源，他們越來越期望能將自己選擇的技術帶入工作場域。

自 Expensify 開始以來，我們的指導原則一直是改善費用管理軟體實際終端使用者的體驗：日常員工。我們設計 Expensify 使其易於設定、整合、配置與使用，幾乎任何裝置都能使用，這讓我們能服務各種類型的員工與所有規模、產業與地理區域的企業。我們的第一個突破是透過我們專利的掃描技術 SmartScan，革新收據追蹤，讓任何人都能簡單地拍攝任何收據 – 不論貨幣或書寫品質如何 – 透過單次點擊即可快速、自動且準確地轉錄收據。在去除人們需要隨身攜帶滿口袋的碎紙收據並花數小時手動追蹤費用的需求後，我們進一步自動化整個費用流程，從最初的收據掃描一直到分類、費用核准、帳務核對與隔日報銷。從那之後，我們已將平台擴展至包含協助企業管理公司信用卡、產生與發送發票、付款、收取款項與預訂旅行等功能，全部來自我們單一、易於使用的行動應用程式。我們打算持續增加補充功能，以留住並為現有客戶增加價值，並吸引新成員。
我們對改善日常員工體驗的強烈關注，使我們能建立一個病毒式、自下而上的商業模式，這是一種資金使用效率高且極具擴展性的模式。透過讓人們花較少時間管理收據，而能花更多時間追求他們真正的目標，我們的成員已採用、支持並將 Expensify 推廣給同事、主管與朋友。我們相信我們快樂的成員是最佳的行銷方式，而我們的自服務、自下而上的方法則利用強大的、自然的口碑採用。
我們的平台背後是一家充滿熱情的公司，並有一種獨特的文化，指導我們所做的一切。我們的公司運作著一個扁平、跨領域的組織結構，並以一套強大的共同價值觀為基礎，促進我們員工的長期快樂與留任。我們商業模式的效率使我們能優先吸引、留住並激勵那些有才華、有抱負且謙虛、致力於長期願景的優秀人才。
我們是一支喜歡解決實際問題的團隊，雖然費用報表對大多數人來說是個問題，但我們也想幫助解決這個世界上的其他迫切問題。
由於規模較小，中小企業通常會有一個人負責發現與實作新系統，這項責任往往會在他們的核心職務功能之外。因此，中小企業在採用新技術時有特定的需求：
•易於發現。由於職務責任涵蓋多個功能，中小企業沒有足夠的頻寬與專業知識來發現、會面與評估多家科技供應商。因此，中小企業越來越依賴線上管道來尋找新技術，並高度考量專家、朋友與同事的推薦。
•容易實施。中小企業的資訊科技部門往往只有一個人或由企業主自己擔任，他們無法抽離時間來支援複雜的實施、維護與培訓需求。因此，中小企業偏好容易實施、上手與整合且需要最少持續維護的解決方案。
•容易購買。由於沒有採購部門且資源有限，中小企業做出購買決策的個人通常偏好提供透明、自服務月訂閱方案的供應商，且可透過信用卡付款。
•容易管理。與大型企業偏好多種、客製化點對點解決方案以處理專門的業務流程不同，中小企業偏好來自單一供應商的單一、全面性平台，以解決多種痛點。
•容易使用。許多中小企業優先考量易用性與便利性，而非成本，並尋求具備優雅、直覺式使用者體驗的解決方案，無需培訓或專業知識即可操作。

paragraphs: 下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們經審計之合併財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表及其他內容載於本年度報告表 10-K 中。此討論包含基於目前計畫、預期及信念的展望性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的有重大差異，原因包括但不限於「風險因素」及本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分所列之因素。

Expensify 是一個基於雲端的費用管理軟體平台，協助從最小規模到最大規模的企業簡化他們管理金錢的方式。每天，來自世界各地各類組織的人們使用 Expensify 掃描並報銷飛機票、酒店、咖啡廳、辦公用品及 ride share 的收據。自 2008 年成立以來，我們已將超過 15 百萬名成員加入我們的社羣，並在 2025 年 12 月 31 日時，透過我們的平台處理並自動化超過 1.8 十億筆費用交易，使人們花較少時間管理費用，而有更多時間做他們喜愛的事。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結訖的會計年度中，平均有 650,000 名已付款成員，來自平均 39,700 家公司，以及超過 200 個國家與地區的使用者使用 Expensify 來簡化金錢管理。
我們以員工為中心的產品策略、病毒式與自下而上的商業模式、口碑傳播的採用以及獨特的公司文化，共同驅動我們成員的價值與我們的競爭優勢。我們相信，如果我們持續專注於我們的終端使用者成員，並開發優秀的產品，我們的成員將會持續推動採用。
我們主要透過我們雲端平台的年度訂閱費來產生收入，這取決於每月活躍的已付款成員數量。個人或公司會為自己、員工及承包商支付訂閱費，我們 collectively 稱為成員。我們將客戶定義為任何為自己及零或多個其他成員支付費用的成員，這些成員被歸類為一個或多個「費用政策」。這可能是個人、整家公司，或較大公司的部門。客戶的定義 inherently 排除 Track 或 Submit 計畫的獨資經營者。
我們透過 Expensify 卡卡的交易來獲取收益，透過所有在卡上消費的 interchange 收取費用。隨著我們平台的擴張，我們持續增加整合的數量，並更積極地透過與費用管理以外的補充使用案例推廣 Expensify 卡，以吸引新舊客戶，推動更高的採用率。
我們透過 Expensify Travel 的預訂來獲取收益，對每筆預訂收取預訂費用。我們有意持續開發補充功能，以增加現有公司使用 Expensify Travel 的數量，並吸引新客戶。
我們的表現取決於許多因素，包括以下內容：投資於產品驅動成長

我們持續專注於增加我們平台上的已付款成員數量。相較於其他軟體公司，我們在產品開發上投資更多，銷售上投資較少。這種產品投資使我們能夠開發易於使用但功能強大的功能，鼓勵人們採用我們的平台。我們增長已付款成員的能力取決於我們的病毒式、自下而上的採用週期，這個週期從一名員工開始。員工下載我們的免費應用程式提交費用，並體驗 Expensify 的好處後，會熱情地在公司內推廣我們的平台，透過口碑傳播或邀請其他
員工與經常用來說服決策者全面採用 Expensify。為持續成長，我們認為必須持續優先投資於我們的平台，以讓會員感到滿意並推動病毒式擴張。
我們的成功取決於將試用 Expensify 免費功能的用戶轉化為付費會員。雖然我們的病毒模式意味著員工或承包商經常將 Expensify 引入中小型企業（"SMBs"），但公司則會訂閱並支付我們大多數付費會員的費用。

我們的病毒式與口耳相傳的採用模式之所以有效，部分原因在於我們已建立為 SMBs 費用管理領域的知名領導者。我們進行大規模的品牌廣告宣傳，以推廣我們的平台優勢，並建立市場共識，認為 Expensify 是費用管理軟體的領導品牌。例如，在 2024 年和 2025 年，我們投資於一個促銷行銷機會，使 Expensify 在 Apple 最大的預算電影《F1® The Movie》中被廣為宣傳，該電影於 2025 年 6 月 27 日在戲院上映。我們認為投資於市場共識使我們能專注於為會員創造優秀的病毒式功能，而非依賴傳統銷售與行銷的低毛利、無法擴展的活動來推動客戶採購。

費用管理涉及公司許多部門。為提供給客戶順暢的體驗，我們與 SMBs 及其員工日常使用的會計、ERP 和旅行軟體進行整合。我們也與許多產生最多收據的科技供應商進行無摩擦整合，例如 Uber 和 Lyft。Expensify 提供一個費用管理平台，我們認為客戶喜歡，且能將我們嵌入組織中。由於這兩個因素，我們歷來享有高客戶留存率，通常優於企業留存率。我們認為另一個推動我們留存率的因素是，SMBs 通常較少頻繁地重新評估其科技解決方案，因此很少會有意識地選擇是否繼續使用 Expensify 一年。

總體品牌留存率與淨座位留存率是衡量客戶滿意度與平台使用情況的重要指標。我們計算總體品牌留存率的方式為：以（a）在前一年結尾期間內曾有五個或更多付費會員支付訂閱費用的公司數量為分母，以及（b）在較近期期間內仍支付至少一個訂閱費用的相同公司數量為分子。在 2025 年和 2024 年，我們的年度總體品牌留存率為 81%。我們計算淨座位留存率的方式為：以（a）在前一年結尾期間內曾有五個或更多付費會員支付訂閱費用的公司所擁有的付費會員座位數為分母，以及（b）在較近期期間內相同公司所擁有的付費會員座位數為分子。在 2025 年和 2024 年，我們的淨座位留存率分別為 88% 和 86%。我們的成長將取決於我們保留現有客戶的能力。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們過往的季度及年度營運結果曾出現波動，未來也可能出現顯著波動，可能未達我們或投資人及證券分析師的預期。
若我們未能有效適應及回應快速變化的技術、演進中的產業標準及變動中的客戶需求或偏好，我們的平台可能變得較不具競爭力。
我們可能無法準確預測吸引新客戶、留住現有客戶及回應變動市場條件所必需的最佳定價策略。
我們面臨著激烈的競爭，我們所處的市場快速演進，若我們無法有效競爭，將可能對我們的營運結果及財務狀況造成傷害。
經濟衰退或經濟不確定性可能對我們的客戶造成負面影響，並對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生重大且不利的影響。
我們的業務依賴強大的品牌，若我們無法維持並提升我們的品牌，我們擴展客戶羣的能力建可能受損，並對我們的業務及營運結果造成傷害。
我們預期將持續對業務成長進行大量投資及支出。
paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報表 10-K 所包含或參考的其他資訊，包括本公司合併財務報表及相關附註，以及本公司向 SEC 提交的其他申報文件。上述任何事件或發展發生，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景造成重大且不利的影響。在這種情況下，本公司 A 級普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，您可能會失去全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或認為不具重大影響，也可能會影響本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景。
本公司每季及每年的營運成果，包括營收水準、營運資金與現金流，過去有顯著變動，未來也可能有顯著變動，因此營運成果的期別比較可能無法提供有意義的參考。本公司每季及每年的財務結果可能因多種因素而波動，許多因素為本公司所無法控制，且可能難以預測，包括但不限於：
•本公司平台整體需求及平台內個別功能需求的水準；
•本公司能否維持或提高毛利率（如 Part II, Item 7 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 所述）與淨座位留存率，擴大組織內的使用率，留住並增加現有客戶的銷售，以及吸引新會員與客戶；
•本公司能否將使用免費功能或試用訂閱的個人與組織轉化為付費客戶；
•本公司能否透過行銷與銷售活動預測性地產生營收；
